instructions.question: Does the poster of this Serbian tweet clearly express a positive feeling (warmth, joy, fun, cheering), a negative feeling (own displeasure, sadness, anger, sharp sarcasm), or neither (neutral)?
instructions.rule: Negative needs the poster's own clear displeasure (hate, boredom, pain, tiredness, sadness, cursing a situation) or a pointed sarcastic or contemptuous jab. Witty generalisations about people, sexes, ages or social media, hyperbolic self-anecdotes, teasing, and opinions without open contempt are neutral. Positive needs clear warmth: laughter, greetings, cheering, compliments, wishes or enjoyment. For headlines, crime or scandal is negative, success or new releases are positive, and routine items are neutral.

neutral.what: Information, plans, questions, quotes, observational humour, generalisations, absurd self-anecdotes, banter, mild opinions and routine news.
examples: Igram tenis kao @DjokerNole  ali nemam milione da to I dokazem. (I play tennis like Djokovic but don't have millions to prove it.)
Ostavila sam upaljen lap top i tv celu noć upss (I left the laptop and TV on all night oops)
Sednica SB UN o Kosovu 10. februara u Njujorku (UN SC session on Kosovo Feb 10 in New York)
neutral.cues: kao (like), jel (is it), upss (oops), :P, remarks about 'ljudi/žene/muškarci' (people/women/men), link shares
neutral.not_for: Explicit personal displeasure or a cutting jab is negative. Clear warmth is positive.

positive.what: Clear warmth, joy, laughter, cheering, greetings, compliments, wishes or enjoyment, even with swearing. Upbeat headlines.
examples: @pUnaVuna jel ti radis ili rtw-ujes :-) Elem, do jaja si :-) (are you working or retweeting :-) anyway, you're awesome)
Ajmoo Doktori @doktorixfactor #xfactoradria (Come on Doktori!)
Serena Vilijams teniserka godine (Serena Williams tennis player of the year)
positive.cues: HAHAHA, ajmo (come on), pozdrav (greetings), do jaja (awesome), car (king), volim (I love), uživam (I enjoy)
positive.not_for: Mock praise is negative. A plain reply with only a smiley is neutral.

negative.what: The poster's own displeasure, boredom, pain, sadness or self-put-downs. Also sharp sarcasm or contempt toward people, politicians or media, and crime or scandal headlines.
examples: Mrzim ponedeljak (I hate Monday)
lepo je sto ih kristina savetuje posto je bas uspela u soubizu <3 (nice that Kristina advises them since she really made it in showbiz <3)
Srpski bokser ubijen zbog ucene (Serbian boxer killed over blackmail)
negative.cues: mrzim (I hate), najgore (the worst), dosadno (boring), bljak (yuck), jebi ga (damn), :( , ubijen (killed)
negative.not_for: Funny exaggerated mishaps without real complaint are neutral.
